model_override.note: SAFETY_JUDGE_MODEL or a studio model; absent means the core's default model

example.message: Answer with the JSON {"ok": true} and nothing else.

response.note: the turn's text; callers also accept text, message or content, nested up to 4 deep (guard/judge.py _reply_text, bin/lib/health.py _words, bin/ask)

response.reader: a bare string, or an object carrying the text under one of response/text/message/content; bin/ask falls back to the whole payload as JSON

notes: A tool-less one-shot completion. The reply is parsed as JSON by guard/judge.py (an object that already has `verdict` is taken as it is; a fenced block or outer braces are accepted). Timeouts: 60s review, READ_TIMEOUT for moltbook, JUDGE_TIMEOUT for the judge, 120s doctor.
